'''Rider''' is a [[skill]] used by certain intelligent creatures to travel on [[mount]]s. A higher skill level allows a rider greater control over a mount, though this is only applicable when the creature attempts to act on its own, such as when it becomes [[status effect|terrified or enraged]].
